verdict.rationale: Alloy documents its own background automation: workflows can run on a recurring schedule as Portfolio workflows, transaction monitoring runs at scheduled times to raise alerts, and events mapped to Source Workflows are routed automatically. The marketing also claims 'agentic automation' for perpetual KYC/AML. This is limited to fraud and compliance decisioning workflows, and each capability is described in a single line. missing for 10: documentation on configuring schedules and triggers, general-purpose automation beyond decisioning workflows, detail on how the agentic automation actually runs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Workflows can run in real time as part of a Journey evaluating an incoming application, or on a schedule as a Portfolio workflow
Monitors transaction events in real time or at scheduled times to detect suspicious activity, apply policy logic, and generate alerts or investigations when thresholds are met.
When enabled, Alloy stores the data submitted on events and automatically routes all requests
Streamline perpetual KYC/KYB, AML, and fraud checks with fully auditable agentic automation
Monitor your portfolio continuously with real-time risk signals
